concerns.text: SC-002 ('verify that the SoCRATES dataset contains all required variables (emotional reactivity, cultural identity) for the analysis') has no implementing task. The coverage table lists FR-001..FR-007, SC-003, SC-005 but omits SC-002 entirely; no task in T101–T114 verifies dataset-variable fit. Add a task (or fold into T101's verification) that checks the generated/derived dataset contains the required variables and reports the result.

concerns.text: Plan task T028b ('Validate logged injected_state matches template', satisfying US-2 AS1: 'the instruction string matches a predefined set of templates... and the specific state label that triggered it is logged') was consolidated away with no surviving equivalent. T105/T106 log injected_state but no task validates the logged state matches the injected instruction template. Add the template-match validation deliverable to T105/T106 or a new task.

US-1 AS2 requires the generation script to complete within 30 minutes and stay within memory capacity on a CPU runner. No task measures or asserts generation runtime/memory (T107 measures only experiment inference throughput). Add a generation-runtime/memory check to T101's verification or a small task.

T112 validates classifier_training_data.json against contracts/trajectory.schema.yaml, but T103's training records (trajectory_id, turn_text, label, confidence_score, threshold_used) do not conform to that schema's required fields (dialogue, metadata, ideal_resolution). The schema-validation coverage exists but is specified against the wrong input; point T112 at a training-data schema or validate only trajectories.jsonl/experiment_logs.json.

Coverage table omits SC-001 and SC-004 rows. Both are substantively covered by T110 (paired test per FR-006, Holm-Bonferroni per FR-007), so this is a table-completeness fix only — add the rows for traceability.
